conceptReferences.prompt: Create a single high-end AAA game environment concept sheet for World of ClaudeCraft's Demon Tower, Floor 1: The Bloodforge. Stylized low-poly/chibi fantasy art direction matching premium Warcraft-like readable shapes, but wholly original. Show one large 16:9 third-person gameplay hero view plus three small callout panels of modular props. Arena terrain is a broad black-iron hexagonal foundry suspended over lava, concentric brass channels, cracked basalt plates, two side forge furnaces, chain gantries, massive demonic anvils, molten sluice trenches with clearly readable safe lanes, orange-red heat haze and sparks. Central landmark is an infernal crucible core, not a generic sphere. Strong silhouettes, restrained palette of soot black, oxidized brass and molten orange; clean navigable combat space, no text, no UI, no logos, no photorealism. Design should be feasible as low-poly GLB modular assets and procedural Three.js terrain.

Create a single high-end AAA game environment concept sheet for World of ClaudeCraft's Demon Tower, Floor 2: The Ossuary of Chains. Stylized low-poly/chibi fantasy art direction matching premium Warcraft-like readable shapes, wholly original. One large 16:9 third-person gameplay hero view plus three small modular-prop callout panels. Terrain is a broad asymmetrical bone-cathedral arena: ivory rib-vault bridges over a dark soul chasm, cracked black stone in a cross-shaped navigable floor, four chained reliquary pylons, colossal horned skull gates, hanging cages, bone organ pipes, purple soul braziers and pale ghost-light. Central landmark is a chained ossuary heart/reliquary. Clear combat lanes, obvious dangerous chasm edges and safe platforms, dramatic vertical silhouettes, palette of bone ivory, charcoal, bruised violet and spectral cyan; no lava, no generic circular room, no text, no UI, no logos, no photorealism. Must be feasible as low-poly modular GLB assets plus procedural Three.js floor geometry.

Create a single high-end AAA game environment concept sheet for World of ClaudeCraft's Demon Tower, Floor 3 final summit: The Void Crown. Stylized low-poly/chibi fantasy art direction matching premium Warcraft-like readable shapes, wholly original. One large 16:9 third-person gameplay hero view plus three small modular-prop callout panels. Arena is a shattered crown-shaped platform high above a cosmic abyss: five jagged obsidian petals linked by narrow broken bridges around a levitating cracked throne-core, chunks of masonry floating upward, enormous curved crown spires, torn crimson banners, void crystals and blue-violet lightning conduits. Parts of the outer ring are missing; luminous magenta fracture lines clearly telegraph dangerous collapse zones while broad safe sectors remain readable. Open storm sky, distant eclipsed moon, volumetric violet mist below, palette of obsidian, cold silver, deep indigo and hot magenta. No lava, no bone cathedral, no generic circle, no text, no UI, no logos, no photorealism. Feasible as low-poly modular GLB assets and procedural Three.js terrain, designed for an epic multi-phase raid boss.
